cohort: The study participants were women undergoing C-sections, specifically focusing on obese women (BMI > 30 kg/m2).
finding: Prophylactic NPWT was found to be useful in reducing the incidence of SSIs and wound complications in women undergoing C-sections.
mod_finding: Subgroup analyses showed that NPWT did not significantly reduce SSI incidence when stratified by the type of C-section (emergency/elective).
